values.meaning: Increased Stored Damage (flat bonus to Overwhelm's stored damage)
values.binNote: Wiki shows the increase as 10/20/30 across R's 3 ranks; the bin's MelR.BasePassiveFlatDamage is [60/70/80] (used in MelR#PassiveFlatDamage with +0.1xAP). These numbers do not match; the bin value may be the total stored flat damage while the wiki states only the increase over the base passive's own value, or the two disagree outright.

Wiki shows the per-stack increase as 1/2/3 across R's 3 ranks; the bin's MelR.BasePassiveStackDamage is [3/4/5] (used in MelR#PassiveStackDamage with +0.0075xAP). These numbers do not match; may be a total-vs-increase discrepancy or a genuine disagreement.

values.quote: {{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} (+ {{ap|4 to 10}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} per [[File:Searing Brilliance.png|20px|link=]] ''Overwhelm'' stack on the target)

mechanics.claim: Golden Eclipse requires an enemy champion affected by Overwhelm to be castable.
mechanics.quote: An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}} is required to cast this ability.

mechanics.claim: Golden Eclipse deals no damage against a target that is untargetable when it resolves.
mechanics.quote: ''Golden Eclipse'' does not deal damage against enemies that are {{tip|untargetable}}.

mechanics.claim: Golden Eclipse can be cast even if all affected targets are untargetable.
mechanics.quote: ''Golden Eclipse'' can be cast even if all affected targets are {{tip|untargetable}}.

mechanics.claim: If a target's Overwhelm stacks would expire during Golden Eclipse's cast time, their duration is extended to 0.75 seconds so the ultimate's damage still applies to them.
mechanics.quote: ''Golden Eclipse'' sets the duration of ''{{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}}'' stacks to {{fd|0.75}} seconds if they would run out during the cast time.
